content:
So, I am personally interested in Shimura varieties, and as far as I know it has not been formalised yet (or have I got this wrong?). I believe reductive groups is still being formalised (again - am I wrong?), and so one cannot start talking about Shimura varieties without those. Hence, I feel like it would probably be too far fetched to start a project on formalising Shimura varieties.

Instead of directly trying to formalise Shimura Varieties, I was considering formalising Hodge structures as a first step - which is something that is useful independent of Shimura varieties. Does someone know if this is an ongoing project? If not, does someone have an opinions on such a project

P.S. I have never actual taken up or collaborated in a Lean project. I am someone who sat alone and learnt lean by solving most of the exercised in the Mathematics in Lean book.
